simple.meaning: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to לָקַח (H3947) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 967 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: לָקַח (lâqach) means to take (in the widest variety of applications) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 2 19.

Num 8:16 (P), Deut 22:7 ; 2Kin 12:6 ; with לְ as dativus commodi [dative of benefit], Zech 11:7 ; ׳ל לַעֲבָדִים לוֺ יְלָדַי אֶתשְֿׁנֵי 2Kin 4:1 to take my two sons for himself for slaves ; so (without לְ reflexive), עוֺלָם לְעֶבֶד תִּקָּחֶנּוּ Job 40:28 wilt thou take him as slave for ever? b. = procure, get , followed by accusative + תֶּבֶן לָכֶם קְחוּ לְ, Exod 5:11 (J) get you straw ; קָלוֺן לוֺ לֹקֵחַ Prov 9:7 getteth to himself shame ; so often, especially לְךָ קַח , etc., Gen 6:21 ; 12:19 ; Genesis 16:21; 45:19 +; without לְ , Neh 5:2 let us procure corn , and eat and live; of acquiring a field Prov 31:16 . c. take possession of , followed by accusative, of land Deut 29:7 ; of men Deut 1:15 ; Josh 3:12 (J E; + לָכֶם ); + מִן Deut 1:23 ; Josh 4:2 (JE). e. especially take in marriage: (I) for another, especially a son, with לִבְנִי אִשָּׁה וְלָקַחְתָּ֫ לְ, , Gen 24:4 and thou shalt take a wifefor my son , so 24:7 ; 24:38 ; 24:40 ; 24:48 (all J), 21:21 (E), Jer 29:6 b; (2) more often for oneself, usually with לְ reflexive (sometimes + לְאִשָּׁה ), Gen 4:19 ; 6:2 ; 11:29 ; 12:19 (all J), + often; without לְ 20:2-3 ,(E), etc. f. = receive, accept , especially a bribe, gift, ransom, etc., 1Sam 8:3 ; 1 Samuel 12: 12:4 (both followed by מִן ), Amos 5:12 ; 2Kin 5:15-16 , 20 , 23 , 26 (twice in verse); Psa 15:5 ; interest-money Ezek 18:13 , 17 ; 22:12 ; inheritance Josh 13:8 ; 18:7 (both D), Num 34:14 (twice in verse); 34:15 (P); of earth, receiving Abel's blood Gen 4:11 (J); chastisement Isa 40:2 ; of perceiving a sound, Job 4:11 mine ear received a whisper of it; receive mentally: בְּעָלָיו וְלָקַח Exod 22:10 (E) i.e. shall accept the oath as satisfactory; לָקַחְתִּי בָּרֵךְ Num 23:20 (JE), i.e. I have received (commandment by revelation) to bless; receive instruction Prov 24:32 ; Jer 2:30 +; entanglements of temptation Prov 22:25 . g. take , as preliminary to further action: Gen 31:34 (E), she took them and put them; Judg 3:25 take key and open; Josh 2:4 she took the two men and hid them; 1Kin 18:4 Obadiah took 100prophets and hid them; 19:21 Elisha took the yoke of oxen and slew them, compare 2Sam 17:19 ; 18:18 ; sometimes wholly redundant, חֲדָשָׁה עֲגָלָה וַעֲשׂוּ קְחוּ 1Sam 6:7 take and prepare a new cart , etc.; somewhat different is נְאֻם וַיִּנְאֲמוּ לְשׁוֺנָם הַלֹּקְחִים Jer 23:31 , i.e. they take (= make use of) their own tongues, and talk oracles. 5 take up, upon = put upon, followed by עַלרֿאֹשָׁהּ אֵפֶר תָּמָר וַתִּקַּת ׃עַל 2Sam 13:19 and Tamar put ashes upon her head ; 17:11 , 2Kin 2:20 ; 4:41 ; עִוִּים גְּדָיֵי שְׁנֵי מִשָּׁם וְקַחלִֿי Gen 27:9 and fetch me thence two kids , compare 27:13 (J); + בְּיָדִי 1Sam 21:9 ; an offering Lev 12:8 (P; || הֵבִיא 12:6 ); with human object often nearly = summon , לְקַחְתִּיךָ אֹיְבַי לָקֹב Num 33:11 (JE) to curse mine enemies did I summon thee , Judg 11:5 ; 1Sam 16:11 ; אֵלַי אֹתוֺ וְקַח שְׁלַח 20:31 send and bring him unto me ; 2Kin 3:15 ; 6:13 +; of ׳י , summoning his people from exile, יְקָּחֶ֑ךָ מִשָּׁם Deut 30:4 . 7 take=lead, conduct (with or without contact): עִמּוֺ בָנָיו אֶתשְֿׁנֵי וַיִּקַּח Gen 48:1 ; קְחוּ בְּקַרְכֶם גַּם Exod 12:32 (both E); עִמּוֺ לָקַח וְאֶתעַֿמּוֺ 14:6 (J) and his people he took with him ; compare 14:7 (J), Josh 8:1 (JE), Judg 4:6 ; אַחֵר אֶלמָֿקוֺם אֶקָּֽחֲךָ Num 23:27 I will take thee unto another place , compare 23:14 ; 23:28 (all J E); ׳י subject, אֶתאֲֿבִיכֶם וָאֶקַּח Josh 24:3 (E) and I took your father Abraham from beyond the river; לְקֻחִים הַצֵּל לַמָּוֶת rescue those led to death. 8 take = capture, seize: בְחָזְקָה לָקַחְתִּי 1Sam 2:16 I will take by force , that is, flesh; of spoils, ל לֹא כֶּסֶף ׳בֶּצַע Judg 5:19 gain of silver they took not ; of capture of ark 1Sam 5:1 ; bronze 2Sam 8:3 , etc.; territory Gen 48:22 (E), Deut 3:14 ; cities Num 21:25 (JE),. Deut 3:14 ; Josh 11:19 (D), 1Sam 7:14 ; 2Sam 8:1 ; of capture of hippopotamus Job 40:24 ; of seductions of woman, בְּעַפְעַמֶּיהָ וְאַלתִּֿקָּֽחֲךָ Prov 6:25 and let her not capture thee with her eyelids. 9 take = carry off: a. as booty Gen 14:11 ; 1Sam 27:9 ; 30:16 , 18 , 19 , 20 ; 1Kin 14:26 (twice in verse). b. as prisoners Gen 14:12 ; 2Kin 18:32 = Isa 36:17 ; 2Kin 23:34 2Chr 36:4 . 10 inphrase take vengeance: מִמֶּנּוּ נִקְמָתֵנוּ וְנִקְחָה Jer 20:10 and we will take our vengeance upon him ; absolute אֶקַּח נָקָם Isa 47:3 vengeance will I take .
